title: Reference solution
description: evals/refs/<task id>.json. A known-good trial for a task: the output, end state, and tool calls that every check on the task must pass. Confirms the task is unambiguous.

task.description: The task id. Must match the task that references this file.

output.description: The final response the agent should give.

state.description: The end state an outcome check reads, keyed the way expect paths address it, e.g. { refunds: { status: processed } }.

transcript.description: Ordered turns, the derived view a judge receives.

note.description: Why this is the right answer.
